sentences.say: Maya runs a tiny import business, and she is owed tariff refunds by U.S. customs.
sentences.cap: Maya runs a tiny import business, and she is owed tariff refunds by U.S. customs.

sentences.say: To collect, she uploads one file to a customs portal called CAPE.
sentences.cap: To collect, she uploads one file to a customs portal called CAPE.

sentences.say: Once it's accepted, she can't edit it, or pull an entry out.
sentences.cap: Once it's accepted, she can't edit it or pull an entry out.

sentences.say: One wrong line stays.
sentences.cap: One wrong line stays.

sentences.say: Cape Refund Desk checks that file before the upload nobody can undo.
sentences.cap: CAPE Refund Desk checks that file before the upload nobody can undo.

sentences.say: Plain code makes every call. Nemotron models explain them. No model ever touches the money.
sentences.cap: Plain code makes every call. Nemotron models explain them. No model ever touches the money.

sentences.say: Maya drops in her entries. Here, a synthetic sample of sixty-nine.
sentences.cap: Maya drops in her entries. Here, a synthetic sample of 69.

sentences.say: Nemotron Lightning cleans the messy columns. Nemotron Ultra reads the hard ones.
sentences.cap: Nemotron Lightning cleans the messy columns. Nemotron Ultra reads the hard ones.

sentences.say: Four lanes. Thirty-nine clear to file, thirteen to fix first, two for her broker, and fifteen customs would reject.
sentences.cap: Four lanes: 39 clear to file, 13 to fix first, 2 for her broker, 15 customs would reject.

sentences.say: Open one of the fifteen, and you get the exact error customs would return.
sentences.cap: Open one of the 15 and you get the exact error customs would return.

sentences.say: Liquidated a hundred thirty days ago, past the eighty-day window.
sentences.cap: Liquidated 130 days ago, past the 80-day window.

sentences.say: Now the trap. This entry looks like ten and a half thousand dollars.
sentences.cap: Now the trap. This entry looks like $10,500.

sentences.say: But thirteen thousand one hundred twenty-five of underpaid duty gets netted against it, so claiming would cost her twenty-six hundred twenty-five.
sentences.cap: But $13,125 of underpaid duty gets netted against it. Claiming would cost her $2,625.

sentences.say: Ultra explains why her broker must decide first, and shows its reasoning.
sentences.cap: Ultra explains why her broker must decide first, and shows its reasoning.

sentences.say: Models slip. In an earlier recording, Ultra wrote that seven entries expire today.
sentences.cap: Models slip. In an earlier recording, Ultra wrote that 7 entries expire today.

sentences.say: The engine counted one. A number guard corrected it before Maya saw it.
sentences.cap: The engine counted 1. A number guard corrected it before Maya saw it.

sentences.say: She confirms the upload can't be undone, and exports only the safe entries, in the format customs publishes.
sentences.cap: She confirms the upload can't be undone, and exports only the safe entries in the format customs publishes.

sentences.say: Her broker uploads it. We never ask for a login.
sentences.cap: Her broker uploads it. We never ask for a login.

sentences.say: Customs changes its rules, so the desk checks the live page against a July copy.
sentences.cap: Customs changes its rules, so the desk checks the live page against a July copy.

sentences.say: Four changes touch these checks, like warehouse entries now being rejected. A second search service confirms them independently.
sentences.cap: Four changes touch these checks, like warehouse entries now being rejected. A second search service confirms them independently.

sentences.say: Each run leaves a Token Factory receipt.
sentences.cap: Each run leaves a Token Factory receipt.

sentences.say: Lightning did all sixty-nine entries for about half a cent. Ultra's reasoning cost about eleven cents.
sentences.cap: Lightning did all 69 entries for about half a cent. Ultra's reasoning cost about 11 cents.

sentences.say: Cape Refund Desk. Check the file before the upload nobody can undo.
sentences.cap: CAPE Refund Desk. Check the file before the upload nobody can undo.

sentences.say: It's live, and open source. Prepared for broker review, not legal advice.
sentences.cap: It's live, and open source. Prepared for broker review. Not legal advice.
